families: within each dataset and background: 4 motifs

sampling_check.enumeration: all binary A/C strings length 1 through 8 grouped by endpoints and adjacent-pair counts; 16 draws per source
sampling_check.threshold: every outcome frequency within sqrt(n/2 * log(2*K/0.001)) of n/K; union bound across all K outcomes in all five spaces
sampling_check.interpretation: fixed diagnostic threshold, empirical evidence only, no proof of uniformity

policy: Freeze input bytes, motifs, protocol, generator, implementation and seeds before evaluation; never select background based on significance. No tuning to results. Report all conditions and failures.
